# Czechia — notes

- Source: Policie ČR "Statistické přehledy kriminality" year-end workbooks (period 1.1.–31.12.) for 2008–2025, one sheet per krajské ředitelství policie (14 kraje) plus Česká republika. 2008–2014 files are .xls "Statistický výkaz č. 1"; 2015 is a zip with the same xls; 2016 (only on the new policie.gov.cz page "Statistické přehledy kriminality za roky 2016–2025") and 2017–2025 are xlsx "sest_01a" December files (cumulative, so December = full year). The 2026 page exists but is a partial year and was not used.
- Kept: TSK 101–106 (vraždy by motive), the "Vraždy celkem" line (101-106; from 2016 labelled 100-106), 115 zabití (§141), 116 usmrcení z nedbalosti (§143; absent in 2008–2009 sheets). Both registered ("Zjištěno"/"REGISTROVÁNO") and cleared ("Objasněno") counts are in rows.csv as separate measures. Column layout changes: 2008–2009 cleared count in column 5, 2010–2015 in column 7, 2016+ column 4.
- Area naming: 2008–2009 sheets name the kraj (e.g. "STŘEDOČESKÝ"), 2010–2015 name "KŘP ... KRAJE", 2016+ use short sheet names; all normalised to the kraj name. KŘP territories coincide with the 14 administrative kraje.
- The 2016+ xlsx has an extra sheet "ICP" (cizinecká policie) which I skipped. Police warning: figures from 2016 onward not comparable with earlier years (system rebuild), offender-age change, Oct 2020 damage-threshold change.
- Okres (district) level: these national workbooks do not give okresy; district tables exist in the "Mapy kriminality" application (kriminalita.policie.cz) and in each KŘP's own pages but were not extracted here.
- Licence: no licence stated on the statistics pages. The police open-data catalogue (policie.gov.cz/opendata/catalogue) states datasets are "volně přístupné k libovolným (legálním) účelům využití, bez licenčních omezení", but that catalogue only holds organisational registers, not these crime workbooks.
- Pre-2008: archive page lists zip/rar "statistiky 2000–2007" (https://archiv.policie.gov.cz/clanek/archiv-statistiky-statisticke-prehledy-kriminality.aspx) not extracted.
